newsitem.title: NICARAGUA: Five policemen hurt in clash in Nicaragua.
newsitem.headline: Five policemen hurt in clash in Nicaragua.

text.p: At least five policemen were hurt on Wednesday during a clash between police and marching university students, radio reports said.
University students in Nicaragua have been marching regularly since May 26 to protest a reduction in the government's education budget. About 170 people have been hurt since then in street battles.

"A group that was nearing the end of a march started a battle with (homemade) mortars ... against police guarding the National Assembly," Police Capt. Justo Zamora told a local radio station on Wednesday.
At least three of the policemen were said to be seriously injured.
